videos.title: Christmas on Every Page
videos.description: A woman returns home for the holidays to help her mother's struggling bookstore. As she reconnects with her roots, she starts to question whether success is measured by career milestones -- or by love, creativity, and the joy of truly belonging.

videos.title: Christmas Angel
videos.description: Ashley gets a new job from her neighbor Nick as his assistant in the best work: being a Secret Santa. Nick has sworn her to secrecy, which includes her new friend Will, a reporter in search of a Christmas story for his magazine.

videos.title: Call Me Mrs. Miracle
videos.description: Mrs. "Miracle" Merkle (Doris Roberts) helps save a struggling department store during the Christmas season.

videos.title: Santa, Maybe
videos.description: Theater director Lila must rise to the challenge of putting on the perfect Christmas ballet alongside a difficult new colleague, while also discovering her office secret Santa in the process.

videos.title: Matchmaker Christmas
videos.description: As the Christmas party for a book publishing company approaches, editor Maggie volunteers to help her boss, Amanda, find a date.

videos.title: Love at the Christmas Contest
videos.description: Angie enters a tree decorating contest to honor the memory of her mother. To Angie's surprise, her high school sweetheart, David, and his daughter, Gabby, have entered the contest as well.

videos.title: Christmas Time Is Here
videos.description: A small-town real estate agent desperately tries to convince her widowed father not to sell the family resort to a prospective buyer.

videos.title: Mrs. Miracle
videos.description: A single man (James Van Der Beek) hires a nanny (Doris Roberts) to help him care for his 6-year-old twins.

videos.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
videos.description: A city manager recruits the help of a childhood friend to save his town's Christmas charity event, while she attempts to set him up with her close friend.

videos.title: The Spruces and the Pines
videos.description: The Spruces and the Pines, rival tree farm-owning families, have been feuding for years. When the respective heirs fall in love, they must keep their growing romance a secret, or they'll risk a Christmas blow-up that could destroy everything.

videos.title: Tails of Christmas
videos.description: Caleb gets injured in the army and begins recovering through help from shelter therapy dogs. As a sign of thanks, Caleb returns home to help Amber run the local shelter and in the process, discovers his feelings for Amber go beyond gratitude.

videos.title: Merry Kissmas
videos.description: A magical kiss in an elevator leaves a woman (Karissa Staples) torn between two men at Christmastime.

videos.title: Christmas in Midnight Clear
videos.description: A real estate developer plans to modernize an economically struggling town from the inside out. However, when she meets the local pastor and pillar of the community, her vision faces more than legal challenges as something deeper begins to blossom.

videos.title: Coupled Up for Christmas
videos.description: Tiffany finally reunites with her longtime crush, Brett, only to find out he has a serious girlfriend. She decides to pair up with a recently heartbroken Peter to win back the affection of their respective soulmates.

videos.title: Christmas North of Nashville
videos.description: A woman rediscovers love, community, and the holiday spirit after returning home to save her family's Christmas carnival.

videos.title: Love Always, Santa
videos.description: A widow's daughter writes to Santa Claus, asking for her mother to find love again. When a struggling writer receives the letter, he finds new inspiration and the beginnings of a romance.

videos.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
videos.description: Rival real estate agents both make the same wish during the first snow of the winter: to win the most coveted listing in town. As the business competitors begrudgingly work together, they learn the house comes with a special commission: love.

videos.title: Christmas by Candlelight
videos.description: Juliet pitches selling Christmas memory candles to her boss, and asks candle store owner Tom to create new scents. He refuses at first but agrees after realizing the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

videos.title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
videos.description: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

videos.title: Christmas Sweethearts
videos.description: When a woman returns home to find her ex in a relationship, she enlists her best friend to act as her fake boyfriend.

videos.title: Our Christmas Wedding
videos.description: Roles reverse as Nicole's boss plans newly engaged Nicole and Michael's wedding in two weeks at Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
videos.description: A woman receives help from a selfless neighbor when an arm injury puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy.

videos.title: Snowmance
videos.description: A true romantic finally gets her chance at the love she's always dreamed of when a little Christmas magic brings her snowman to life.

videos.title: Pencil Me in for Christmas
videos.description: An aspiring illustrator teams up with a demanding author to work on a children's book. As they create their Christmas-themed project in a nostalgic small town, they find themselves rediscovering the holiday spirit.

videos.title: Christmas at Mistletoe Manor
videos.description: When a cooking show influencer travels to a centuries-old English castle to honor a World War II nurse, she finds herself swept up by the castle's holiday magic and the unexpected warmth of its charming proprietor.

videos.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
videos.description: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

videos.title: The Christmas Calendar
videos.description: When Emily, a struggling baker in a small town, receives a handmade Christmas calendar from a secret admirer, the local residents become obsessed with finding out the identity of the sender.

videos.title: Love at the Christmas Contest
videos.description: Angie enters a tree decorating contest to honor the memory of her mother. To Angie's surprise, her high school sweetheart, David, and his daughter, Gabby, have entered the contest as well.

videos.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
videos.description: A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of "The Nutcracker.".

videos.title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson
videos.description: A woman takes a shot at love after seeing a widowed firefighter and chef on a cooking show. With the help of his daughter, the two of them might find love this Christmas.

videos.title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
videos.description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

videos.title: A Christmas Star
videos.description: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

videos.title: 12 Games of Christmas
videos.description: Two old friends and a group of their neighbors are transported into a Christmas-themed board game during a Christmas party.

videos.title: The Great Christmas Switch
videos.description: In an effort to get away from their problems, identical twins Bianca, a single city girl with a Scrooge-like boss, and Kaelynn, a single mother of two, decide to switch places for Christmas.

videos.title: Destined at Christmas
videos.description: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again.

videos.title: Matchmaker Christmas
videos.description: As the Christmas party for a book publishing company approaches, editor Maggie volunteers to help her boss, Amanda, find a date.

videos.title: Christmas Lovers Anonymous
videos.description: A best-selling author hides her love for Christmas after an ugly break-up, but finds love again when she joins a website for people who are crazy about Christmas.
